Correlation between dementia risk factors from Lee et al

dementiacor.Rd

Pairwise tetrachoric correlations between the 12 dementia risk factors (exposures) in the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities (ARIC) study, from eTable 2 of the supplement of Lee et al. These correlations describe how the exposures co-occur within individuals and were used to compute the communality of each risk factor (see the communality column of dementiarisk).

Usage

dementiacor

Format

A symmetric 12 x 12 correlation matrix with row and column names given by the risk factors (in the same order as dementiarisk$risk_factor).

Note

These are correlations between exposures, not between the estimates of the relative risks. They should not be used as a covariance for beta.

References

Lee, Mark, et al. "Variation in population attributable fraction of dementia associated with potentially modifiable risk factors by race and ethnicity in the US." JAMA network open 5.7 (2022): e2219672-e2219672.

See also

dementiarisk for the relative risks, prevalence estimates and communalities
